gen-dafont-outrun-future-fs-bespoke-sans: A line of constant width traces every Outrun Future letter, spaced wide apart like neon tubes bent into shape. Bespoke Sans takes over below with sharper, refined curves, and its moderate lowercase would keep a long page of text moving smoothly.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-epunda-slab: Synthwave authority runs through Outrun Future, every stroke the same width with no pinched joints or flared ends. And Epunda Slab, a classic serif, gaps its c wide open, so a long passage feels tall, rounded and dignified.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One is a literary serif with a tall middle band. Outrun Future does its best work in gentle, monotone lines of wide-set display lettering, while the serif is happiest when its shallow ascenders and welcoming e carry the sentences.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-glegoo: Outrun Future draws its authoritative letters with a marker-nib line that ignores direction, spaced far apart. Then Glegoo, a classic serif with big counters and a tall lowercase, brings an editorial polish that feels like a quiet answer to all that neon.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-hanuman: Wide-set synthwave swagger, with bowls that never thin at the sides and a big x-height over short ascenders. Hanuman, a traditional serif, would read with a high-waisted lowercase and refined ease.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-kadwa: Kadwa reads open-ended, with generous curves and a big x-height. Its classic serif, editorial manner suits bigger text sizes best, and Outrun Future glows above it as if drawn in a neon tube.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-scope-one: Outrun Future looks like it was drawn with a fixed-width nib, wide-spaced and authoritative with its big x-height and short ascenders. Scope One, a traditional serif, spills its counters outward beneath it.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-suwannaphum: Suwannaphum, a classic serif, opens its c like a bent paperclip and lifts its x-height like a squared-off woodblock letter. And Outrun Future, with strokes like fine rope, leaves a long passage feeling dignified and editorial.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-inter: A constant-width outline, easy to trace with a finger, defines Outrun Future. It is made for synthwave authority up top, while Inter, a plain sans, lets its big counters breathe in a smooth, tube-like line below.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-mulish: Outrun Future spaces its authoritative letters wide, in one constant outline with short ascenders. Mulish, a plain sans with no thick-and-thin modulation, handles the modern, approachable talking with horseshoe-open apertures.
